title: System of Equations Solver
description: Solve 2×2 systems by elimination and 3×3 systems by Gaussian elimination, with every step shown.
howto: Type the coefficients of each equation.
Press Solve system to see the elimination steps and the solution.

faqs.q: What if there is no unique solution?
faqs.a: A zero determinant (2×2) or zero pivot (3×3) means the system is inconsistent (no solution) or dependent (infinitely many) — the tool says which.
Rows are combined to zero out entries below the diagonal (forward elimination), then variables are solved bottom-up (back substitution).
Yes — the 2×2 solution is plugged back into both equations so you can verify the residuals.
